tasks.short: Organize campaign operations and fundraising events

steps.what: Determine actual campaign-organization and fundraising-event priorities, roles and resource constraints
Coordinate actual organizer availability, venue arrangements and event responsibilities with campaign staff
Prepare the actual event logistics plan used by campaign staff with venue, timing, roles and required supplies
Assemble the exact administrative calendar notices from checked event details and the existing organizer roster
Check the final logistics plan and exact organizer notices under the actual campaign coordinator's scheduling responsibility
Send the exact authorized administrative notices to the existing event organizers
Attend to actual organization and event issues with the campaign staff and fundraising hosts

tasks.design: Use actual logistics-plan fields in {PROJECT} and {DOCS} to assemble administrative organizer notices in {CALENDAR} and {EMAIL}. The legislator and actual campaign coordinator retain priorities, direct coordination, exact notice checks and event issues.
tasks.previous_blocker: Actual organizer logistics can repeat venue, timing and role fields across plans and administrative notices.
tasks.enabler_now: Explicit event fields support deterministic notice assembly and version-bound sending.
tasks.still_hard: Availability, responsibilities and event changes need real coordination.
tasks.human_edge: The legislator and staff understand actual organization needs and resolve practical issues.

ambition.what: No automated campaign strategy, voter targeting or political persuasion.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: explicit event fields can reduce administrative notice assembly and sending while actual campaign organization decisions remain human.

assumptions: Boundary is actual administrative campaign organization and fundraiser logistics, not donation solicitation copy, audience selection or political messaging. The existing organizer roster is used without targeting or scoring people.
s1 and s2 count actual priorities, availability and responsibility capture. No clean new event feed or newly required record is assumed. The real logistics plan is used by event staff.

s3 removes5 of20 repeated venue/role/header placement units and retains15 for actual plan writing and checks. s4 prices only actual repeated notice assembly; test native event templates first and credit no existing automatic work.

s5 represents the actual coordinator's existing scheduling responsibility, not a newly invented supervisor or author self-approval. The exact notices exist before review; changed detail or recipient voids a1. Upkeep includes failed send/mapping repair.

s6 is a real notice send; ordinary working persistence is negligible within plan preparation without saving or a gate. All actual coordination and event issue work remain human. Shares are unmeasured estimates.
research_questions: Which administrative notice fields remain manually copied after current calendar templates?

already_counted.description: Actual priorities, availability coordination, retained logistics writing and event issue handling remain counted.
Existing coordinator's exact scheduling/notice check remains outside focal labour.

incremental.description: Maintain event/notice mappings and repair failed administrative sends.

approvals.approved_version: Exact organizer notices assembled in s4 and checked in s5; changed venue, timing, role or recipient requires renewed review.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B95 R65 gives gross31.5789 less upkeep3, net28.5789, high28.5. Low: changing venue details and organizer roles retain18 of20 notice units and18 of20 logistics-plan units, with only4 of5 send units eligible;8/95*100 less3 upkeep gives5.421, low5.4. Actual priorities and coordination remain full.

tasks.short: Oversee expense allowances and year-end balances

steps.what: Read the actual expense allowance accounts and identify the applicable period, allowance rules and supporting entries
Match actual allowance entries and calculate the specified year-end account reconciliation and differences
Investigate actual unmatched entries and allowance questions with the responsible accounts staff
Review actual year-end balance status and identify unresolved allowance matters for the responsible accounts route
Write the actual unresolved-item and balance-status entry used by accounts staff in the existing allowance tracker
Save the ordinary oversight entry in the same allowance tracker

tasks.design: Build a fixed allowance reconciliation from actual {EXPENSE} and {ERP} entries, replacing only current manual matching in {SPREADSHEET}. Keep source review, exception investigation, year-end oversight and the actual tracker entry with the legislator.
tasks.previous_blocker: Allowance oversight can require repeated matching and balance calculations across actual account entries.
tasks.enabler_now: Explicit identifiers, periods and matching rules can produce a draft reconciliation without authorizing payments or ledger corrections.
tasks.still_hard: An arithmetically balanced account can still contain an unsupported or misclassified expense.
tasks.human_edge: The legislator questions actual exceptions and follows unresolved matters through the responsible accounts route.

ambition.what: No automated reimbursement, ledger posting or fiscal certification.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: fixed entry matching and balance rules can support allowance oversight while exception investigation remains human.

assumptions: Actual finance staff produce account entries through real work outside focal labour; s1 counts this legislator's source/period verification. No new clean allowance feed or free manual capture is presumed.

Boundary is oversight and actual status tracking, not payment approval, ledger corrections or formal year-end certification. Those actual actions need their own real authority and separate final-version action.
The status tracker is an actual existing record used by accounts staff; do not add it if none is kept or read. Its writing9 and negligible save1 remain fully retained and ungated.

Test native account reconciliation first; existing matching and calculations earn zero new gain. s2 applies only to actual current manual matching. s3 retains investigation and upkeep includes failed import/mapping repair. Shares are unmeasured estimates.
research_questions: Which allowance matching is manual after current expense/ledger reports?

already_counted.description: Actual source reading, exception investigation, year-end judgment and real tracker writing remain counted.

incremental.description: Maintain allowance reconciliation mappings and repair failed imports.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R75 gives gross25 less upkeep3, net22. Low: allowance period and account identifiers differ across entries, retaining19 of25 matching units;6 saved less3 upkeep gives3. Investigation and actual oversight remain full.

steps.what: Read actual district-industry and product information and locate current factual source references
Discuss actual district industries' capabilities and practical promotion needs with their representatives
Prepare and verify the actual factual industry/product presentation used in district promotion meetings

loop.purpose: Suggest factual presentation prose from actual industry/product sources
loop.input: Checked industry capabilities, product facts and presentation scope
loop.output: Draft factual presentation with source pointers
loop.check: Legislator verifies every product, capability, quantity and attribution against the actual supplied sources
loop.stop: Two drafts then unsupported statements are removed and remaining preparation stays manual
loop.why_not_simpler: Fixed layouts handle headings but explaining actual industry capabilities requires semantic writing

steps.what: Present the actual district industries and products in general promotion meetings and answer factual questions

tasks.design: Link actual source references in {OTHER}, the district economic-information reference set, and {DOCS}. A bounded drafting helper supports factual industry/product explanations while the legislator checks the claims and conducts actual promotion meetings.
tasks.previous_blocker: Factual meeting preparation can repeat source navigation and presentation writing.
tasks.enabler_now: Native reference links and source-bound drafting support those specific preparation actions.
tasks.still_hard: Claims about capabilities and products must reflect actual sources and practical limits.
tasks.human_edge: The legislator understands the district's industries and takes responsibility for the explanation.

ambition.what: No automated political persuasion, audience targeting or commercial commitment.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: source-linked drafting can support factual industry presentations while actual claim checking and representation remain human.

assumptions: Boundary is general factual economic/industry promotion, not election messaging, personal targeting or an endorsement contract. Actual publication, dispatched material or commercial commitment needs its real final-version authority and separate action.
s1 reads actual sources and s2 captures real representative accounts; s3 includes source selection and every factual check. No free clean presentation dataset is presumed.
s1 removes2 of20 reference-navigation units and retains18 for source reading. s3 retains12 of20 preparation/check units and upkeep includes1 extra manual failed-draft correction unit.

Test existing reference links and presentation layouts first; existing support earns zero new gain. Ordinary working persistence is negligible within preparation, without saving or author approval. No trailing meeting report is invented. Shares are unmeasured.
research_questions: Can actual factual preparation be shortened without unsupported product/capability claims?

already_counted.description: Actual source reading, industry discussion, retained factual preparation/checking and live presentation remain counted.

incremental.description: Maintain presentation/source checks2; manually correct failed drafts1.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R90 gives gross10 less upkeep3, net7. Low: an unfamiliar product category lacks compatible source passages, retaining19.5 of20 reference units and18 of20 preparation units;2.5 saved is below3 upkeep, net clamped0. Industry conversation and live presentation remain full.

tasks.short: Represent government at meetings and conferences

steps.what: Read the actual government mandate and meeting agenda and locate the applicable briefing references
Travel to and attend the actual local, national or international meeting or conference
Represent the government directly in the actual meeting, explain its authorized position and engage with participants
Discuss actual meeting outcomes and unresolved questions with the responsible government colleagues

tasks.design: Link the actual government mandate and briefing pages to the meeting in {CALENDAR} and {DOCS}. Keep mandate reading, travel, actual representation and outcomes discussion with the legislator.
tasks.previous_blocker: Finding the applicable mandate and briefing version can require separate navigation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native calendar/briefing links remove retrieval without setting or changing the government's position.
tasks.still_hard: Live representation requires understanding the mandate and the actual discussion.
tasks.human_edge: The legislator recognizes questions that exceed the authorized position and takes them back to colleagues.

ambition.what: No automated government representation or binding agreement.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: meeting-linked briefing references can shorten retrieval while government representation and travel remain human.

assumptions: Boundary is actual meeting representation and oral outcomes discussion, not negotiating or signing a binding agreement. Any actual commitment, formal statement dispatch or written report needs its real work and separate final-version authority/action.
s1 counts actual mandate/briefing reading and removes3 of20 navigation units, retaining17 for substantive preparation and checks. Existing native links earn zero new gain.
Travel20, live meeting55 and actual outcomes discussion5 remain full. No trailing travel report or meeting note is invented where nobody keeps or reads one.
Actual meeting arrangements come from real scheduling work counted there once, not a free new logistical feed. Shares are unmeasured episode estimates.
research_questions: Is any reference search left beyond actual mandate and briefing reading?

already_counted.description: Actual mandate reading, travel, direct government representation and outcomes discussion remain counted.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R97 gives gross3 less upkeep1, net2. Low: a revised international briefing is not linked to the meeting, retaining19 of20 preparation units;1 saved covers1 upkeep, net0. Travel and actual representation remain full.

role.altitude: Campaign organization decisions, allowance oversight, factual industry representation and government meetings remain human while specific administrative assembly and references can shrink.
reach: Work with actual campaign coordinators, accounts staff and briefing owners on exact fields and document provenance.
role.ambitious_version: A legislator with less repeated administrative preparation who retains actual political judgment, financial oversight and public representation.
